questions: Live Nation: livenation.com event pages send ticket buyers to ticketmaster.com. Add ticketmaster.com as a Live Nation host, treat it as its own store, or keep livenation.com alone?

JetBlue Vacations books on jetbluevacations.com, but its FAQ also points to jetblue.com/vacations, which shares the jetblue.com host with the JetBlue airline store. How should that shared host be handled?
Luxair (luxair.lu) is a Luxembourg airline with no U.S. locale seen. Keep it as a store for U.S. shoppers?
Iberia, KLM, Korean Air, LOT and Lufthansa are non-U.S. airlines whose sites have U.S. locales (KLM on klm.us). Keep them as stores?
IHG: the Fiserv code table names IHG hotel brands (Holiday Inn, Inter-Continental, Crowne Plaza), not IHG itself. Is that an acceptable lookup page for ihg.com?

Many stores (Iberia, IHG, IHOP, KFC, Kohl's, Lufthansa, LOT, KLM, King Soopers, Jos. A. Bank, Joss & Main) blocked automated requests; their pages came from search or URL patterns and may need to be captured from a browser.
